description: Jason Guidone in studio with Reese On The Radio, Tuesday, June 16 at 5:00 PM. They discussed Jason's campaign for State Senate following his endorsement by District 19 Republican delegates. As the Republican nominee, Jason shared his vision for uniting the district, affordability, high taxes, government accountability, and putting the people of the 19th District first.
